name: ai-impact
description: Scaling AI activity into business impact. Thinking tools your own AI agent runs with you against your real portfolio — some reflection, some working a number through until it fits your system, some diagnosis. Start at ai-activity-to-impact to find which constraint is in the way; it routes you to the rest. They ask rather than answer, and each ends in one experiment to run.

plugins.name: ai-impact
plugins.description: Turn AI activity into business impact with your own agent and your own material. Start by locating whether you are at activity, output or impact and which constraint the result is waiting on, then work the specific thing: AI traction from what you shipped, initiative readiness, portfolio patterns, operating-model reality, outcome framing, flow metrics, WIP limits once agents write the code. Reflection, working-through and diagnosis — conversational, ending in an experiment rather than a score.
